scripts.setup: pnpm install && cd src/agents && uv sync
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,agents -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @openroute/api dev" "pnpm --filter @openroute/web dev" "pnpm dev:agents"
scripts.dev:agents: cd src/agents && uv run python main.py
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && cd src/agents && uv run pytest -q
